claim: In August 2026, civilian land release and resettlement in the north and east remained active parliamentary and defence-policy business rather than a completed post-war process.
bounded_by: Parliamentary business summary confirms the live policy issue and defence response, but not every local parcel, access condition or acreage claim in the field intake.
notes: Specific Valikamam and Kilinochchi mechanisms remain open questions pending primary parcel-level records.
